facts_raw.Program: Aviva & Founders Factory Fintech Investment Program
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Investment terms not publicly summarized on current program page
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Pre-seed–Series A fintech；与 Aviva / Founders Factory 投资主题匹配。项目当前面向 London & Global founder 开放。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 已有 MVP/客户验证；有明确与 Aviva 18M 客户、保险/财富/地产渠道形成 pilot 或商业合作的场景。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 6个月；London & Global。官方未写必须全程常驻伦敦，实际为全球项目 + 运营支持，关键活动/企业对接可能线下。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未公开统一 visa support；如参加英国线下活动需自行满足入境要求。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Name: Ant Barker / Paul Welsh / Arslan Hannani / Suzanne Lawson / Maria Belezina
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: Program Apply Now；Aviva team names publicly listed on program page.
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: Pre-seed–Series A fintech，尤其保险、财富管理、property、asset management、cybersecurity、AI；希望获取大型金融机构 pilot/distribution 的团队。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 非 fintech；只想拿钱但不需要 corporate pilot / distribution；无法配合6个月高强度 operator support 的团队。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：适合有明确保险/金融 enterprise use case 的团队；核心价值是 Aviva corporate access + FF operator support，不是单纯 £50K。

facts.Program: Aviva & Founders Factory Fintech Investment Program
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Investment terms not publicly summarized on current program page
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Pre-seed to Series A fintech matching Aviva and Founders Factory investment themes. Open to London and global founders.
facts.Strong-to-Have: MVP and customer validation, with a clear pilot or commercial use case involving Aviva's customers or insurance, wealth and property distribution.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Six months, London and global. Full-time London residency is not explicitly required; key events and corporate meetings may be in person.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must meet UK entry requirements for in-person events.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Name: Ant Barker / Paul Welsh / Arslan Hannani / Suzanne Lawson / Maria Belezina
facts.Public Contact Route: Program Apply Now；Aviva team names publicly listed on program page.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Pre-seed to Series A fintech companies, particularly insurance, wealth, property, asset management, cybersecurity and AI, seeking financial-institution pilots or distribution.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Non-fintech teams, those seeking funding without corporate pilots or distribution, or unable to engage in six months of intensive operational support.
facts.Notes: Best for insurance and financial enterprise use cases. The main value is Aviva access and Founders Factory operational support, beyond the cash investment.
